self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Starfire Upon the Snowplains: triggering any Elemental Reaction grants +32% ATK for 12s. Works off-field.

R5 Starfire Upon the Snowplains: triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG by 32% for 12s. Applied as stellarglimmer_dmg_, the umbrella key that reaches both Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl hits, so this buff is correctly scoped for either. Stellar Swirl DMG itself is still unimplemented (no reaction constants), so a Swirl rotation has no hits for it to land on yet. Stacks with afterElementalReaction, since a Stellar Glimmer reaction is also an Elemental Reaction.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).

en.flavor: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

refinements.1: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by <r>16%</r> for 12s. Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by <r>16%</r> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Une épée longue entièrement faite de pierres précieuses, forgée, dit-on, pour la voie de la droiture. Dégainée, elle resplendit d'un éclat de flamme bleue.

refinements.1: Déclencher une réaction élémentaire augmente l'ATQ du personnage équipé de l'arme de <r>16 %</r> pendant 12 s, et déclencher une réaction astrale augmente ses DGT de réaction astrale de <r>16 %</r> pendant 12 s. Les effets susmentionnés peuvent être déclenchés même si le personnage équipé de l'arme fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.
